description: This is a Flutter source file implementing a login screen UI component. It manages user authentication by handling form validation, calling backend API methods, and navigating upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides a login UI, handles user input, performs login API calls, and navigates to the home screen upon success.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class for LoginScreen managing form state, user input controllers, loading state, error messages, and login process.

methods.name: _onLogin
methods.description: Performs login process: validates form, calls login API, retrieves user info, saves token, and navigates to home screen.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up controllers and API client when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the login screen UI, including form fields, buttons, and status messages.
